metadata.name: hetzner
metadata.description: Fixed-profile Hetzner Cloud slots; 0.1.0 source candidate, not installed.

api_token.description: Operator secret-resolved project-scoped Hetzner Cloud bearer; no environment/account fallback.

grant_bearer.description: Separately resolved scoped Core adapter callback bearer; required only for private mutation/recovery receipts.

bootstrap_templates.description: Fixed secret-resolved cloud-init templates, each matching the approved profile SHA256; never caller input/output.

fleet.description: Strict typed operator FleetConfig: project anchor, owner, fixed profiles/slots/floors/ceilings/budgets, default-off mutations and fixed HTTPS grant origin. See docs/FLEET-LIFECYCLE.md.

action_catalog.name: ensure_server
action_catalog.description: Default dry-run fixed-slot server plan; opt-in single-use Core grant sends one native create, uncertainty uses GET-only recovery.

action_catalog.name: observe_servers
action_catalog.description: Observe one operator-scoped slot with exact immutable identity, owner and physical spec; absence does not prove writer quiescence.

action_catalog.name: destroy_server
action_catalog.description: Default dry-run immutable-ID delete; durable drain grant and protected-floor refusal, with separately enabled private failed-create compensation child; no retained data/IP/LB destruction.

action_catalog.name: observe_server_action
action_catalog.description: Native action identity/status tied to owned server or private persisted deletion receipt; no business readiness/fencing claim.

action_catalog.name: observe_fleet_profile
action_catalog.description: Read pinned native type/image/location availability and exact gross hourly/monthly price/currency with freshness horizon; no stock reservation or throughput qualification.

action_catalog.name: observe_fleet_inventory
action_catalog.description: Bounded complete profile membership and exact configured-name collision reads; all native states, immutable tuples and canonical ensure projections, never atomic or useful capacity evidence.

action_catalog.name: observe_failed_server_creation
action_catalog.description: Read an exact settled creation parent, owned partial native lifetime and complete bound failed action history; cleanup identity only, no child authority, writes or healthy physical spec.
